_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Blackbox exporter
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Probes websites, ports and DNS over HTTP, TCP, DNS and ICMP for Prometheus, reporting whether they answer and how fast. Probes are behind a password, so nobody else can use it to reach other hosts.
startup:
pw="{{WEB_PASSWORD}}"; if [ -z "$pw" ]; then [ -s web-password.txt ] || (umask 077; head -c 18 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d "
/+=" > web-password.txt); pw=$(cat web-password.txt); echo "Web password is empty, so the Blackbox exporter uses the password in web-password.txt (username {{WEB_USER}})."; fi; h=$(PW="$pw" perl -e 'my @a = ("a".."z", "A".."Z", 0..9, ".", "/"); print crypt($ENV{PW}, "\$2b\$10\$" . join("", map { $a[rand @a] } 1..22));'); printf "# Raptor writes this file at every start, from Web username and Web password.
basic_auth_users:
  "%s": "%s"
" "{{WEB_USER}}" "$h" > web-auth.yml; exec ./blackbox_exporter --config.file=blackbox.yml --web.listen-address=0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}} --web.config.file=web-auth.yml

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Blackbox exporter: downloads the release for the chosen version from
# GitHub (checked against GitHub's checksum) and writes a first
# blackbox.yml from the release's own. blackbox.yml is never touched; only
# the program is replaced, once the new one has arrived.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "The Blackbox exporter has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag prometheus/blackbox_exporter "$tag") || fail "The Blackbox exporter has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.29.1, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"

if [ -x blackbox_exporter ] && ./blackbox_exporter --version 2>&1 | grep -q "version $version "; then
    echo "Blackbox exporter $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Blackbox exporter $version"
    gh-release download prometheus/blackbox_exporter "$tag" "blackbox_exporter-$version.linux-$arch.tar.gz" "$work/bb.tar.gz"
    tar -xzf "$work/bb.tar.gz" -C "$work" --strip-components=1
    [ -x "$work/blackbox_exporter" ] || fail "The download isn't the Blackbox exporter. Reinstall to try again."
    [ -f blackbox.yml ] || cp "$work/blackbox.yml" blackbox.yml
    mv -f "$work/blackbox_exporter" blackbox_exporter
fi
echo "Installed Blackbox exporter $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Blackbox exporter version to install, such as 0.29.1, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Web username
variables.description: The username for the web interface and API.

variables.name: Web password
variables.description: The password for the web interface and API. Leave it empty to use a random one, saved in web-password.txt.
